hero.title:
Build a Form.
It Does the Rest.
hero.description: 21 field types, drag-and-drop builder, and routing rules that auto-create tickets, CRM leads, and funnel enrollments on submission.

body: Forms support three fill modes: traditional click-and-type, AI-powered chat where customers describe their needs naturally, or voice input where they speak answers and AI transcribes. When a form is submitted, the routing engine evaluates conditional rules — 'if budget exceeds $50K, create a high-priority ticket.' CRM contacts are auto-upserted by email, tickets are created with smart field mapping, leads flow into nurture funnels, and confirmation emails are sent — all in one atomic operation.

crm.title: Auto-CRM + tickets
crm.desc: Submissions auto-upsert CRM contacts (deduped by email) and create tickets with smart field mapping and routing rules.

routing.title: Conditional routing
routing.desc: If budget > $5K → create ticket priority: high. If service = HVAC → assign to Sarah. Rules run automatically on every submission.

embed.title: Website embedding
embed.desc: Embed on your HABOS site with transparent background and auto-height. Cross-origin resize messaging keeps it seamless.

scenario.label: Real scenario
scenario.text: A homeowner visits your website and fills out a quote request for a $8K bathroom renovation. HABOS creates a high-priority ticket (budget > $5K rule), upserts them in CRM, enrolls them in the "warm lead" funnel, and sends a confirmation email — all before you see the notification. When you open the ticket, their full CRM profile, project context, and suggested response are already there.

closing.title:
Other form tools collect data.
HABOS acts on it.
